title: Needle Felt
description: Une esthétique de diorama miniature tactile imitant l'artisanat de la laine feutrée à l'aiguille. Elle présente des palettes pastel douces, une macrophotographie avec une profondeur de champ extrêmement faible et des textures duveteuses et fibreuses éclairées par une lumière de studio douce et diffuse.
description_en: A tactile, miniature diorama aesthetic mimicking needle-felted wool craft. It features soft pastel palettes, macro photography with extreme shallow depth of field, and fuzzy, fibrous textures illuminated by gentle, diffused studio lighting.
description_fr: Une esthétique de diorama miniature tactile imitant l'artisanat de la laine feutrée à l'aiguille. Elle présente des palettes pastel douces, une macrophotographie avec une profondeur de champ extrêmement faible et des textures duveteuses et fibreuses éclairées par une lumière de studio douce et diffuse.
prompt: Photorealistic macro photography of a needle-felted wool miniature diorama. Apply this style to the complete scene described by {{subject}}, preserving its factual content, camera angle, framing, spatial layout, and stated exclusions. The image must occupy the absolute entire dedicated space, full bleed to all four corners, with no borders, no frames, and no white margins. Every element is meticulously crafted from densely matted wool roving, exhibiting a highly tactile, soft, and fuzzy surface. Individual stray fibers catch the light, creating a delicate, fibrous halo around forms. Lighting is soft, diffused studio illumination with gentle rim lights that enhance the volumetric fuzziness without casting harsh shadows, allowing subtle ambient occlusion within the felt crevices. The color science features a high-key, cheerful pastel palette dominated by {{primary_color}} and {{secondary_color}}, punctuated by delicate touches of {{accent_color}}. Edges lack rigid outlines; instead, silhouettes are defined by soft, organic transitions of colored wool. The spatial dynamics rely on an extreme shallow depth of field, characteristic of macro tilt-shift lenses, rendering foreground and deep background elements into a creamy, smooth bokeh. This optical blur enforces a miniature scale and a cozy, handmade atmosphere. The rendering simulates physical stop-motion animation puppets, emphasizing pure material authenticity over digital perfection. The texture reveals the microscopic weave of carded wool, ensuring a plush, pillowy aesthetic.
background_prompt: A soft, rolling miniature landscape crafted entirely from needle-felted wool. The environment features plush, pillowy mounds and abstract geometric shapes in a pastel palette of {{primary_color}}, {{secondary_color}}, and {{accent_color}}. Soft, diffused studio lighting catches the fuzzy, fibrous texture of the matted wool roving. Shot with a macro lens, the extreme shallow depth of field transforms distant felted forms into creamy, smooth bokeh, creating a cozy, tactile atmosphere devoid of any specific subjects or frames.

video.motion: Elements should exhibit a slight, stuttering stop-motion animation style (around 12 frames per second), with physical compression and squash-and-stretch mimicking soft wool being manually manipulated.
video.camera: Camera movements should be restricted to slow, subtle macro dolly pushes or pans, rigorously maintaining the extreme shallow depth of field.
video.temporal_texture: The fuzzy wool fibers must exhibit a subtle 'boil' or jitter frame-to-frame, simulating the tactile nature of stop-motion replacement animation, while soft lighting remains stable.
video.avoid: Avoid high-framerate fluid motion, digital motion blur, sharp hyper-digital edges, and deep focus.
